hi-five.title: Hi Five product specifications
hi-five.note: The overview states 765 mm cover, while the performance section states 755 mm. RoofHub flags this conflict rather than choosing an ordering width.

bitz.title: Roofing products and public prices
bitz.note: Retail listing, not a like-for-like COLORSTEEL specification. Thickness is described as gauge, not confirmed BMT. Effective cover must be confirmed before converting to square metres.

roofcrowd.title: Custom Orb profile, materials and dimensions
roofcrowd.note: Used for specifications. The category price range is not used as a verified per-metre cash price without a confirmed unit and variant.

delta.title: Roof replacement cost NZ, 2025 guide
delta.note: Historical budgeting guide, not a 2026 quotation. It names older coating products. Its price table includes GST, scaffolding and removal/disposal.

arcline.title: Roofing types and prices
arcline.note: Historical budgeting guide. Long-run rate is explicitly based on plan area. GST is not stated. Rates are not current supplier offers.

eh.title: New roof cost NZ: 2026 price guide
eh.note: Broad whole-job estimates, not documented billed projects; GST is not specified.

superior.title: COLORSTEEL roofing cost NZ
superior.note: Provider guide rather than an invoice dataset. Scope and access exclusions need checking in any actual quote.

upwell.title: Published scaffolding hire rate
upwell.note: The quoted square-metre unit is scaffold area, not roof area.

sk.title: Edge protection listing
sk.note: Single-storey listing. Confirm GST, hire period, delivery and establishment inclusions before comparison.

scaffoldme.title: 65 lm single-level house lot
scaffoldme.note: Equipment seller recounting a builder rental example. This is not a nationwide four-plank hire tariff.

zincalume.title: ZINCALUME product information
zincalume.note: Describes the 2025 transition to the AM125 aluminium/zinc/magnesium coating. Historical AZ specifications are not treated as current.

durability.title: NZ Building Code clause B2 and durability

tiles-cop.title: Pressed metal tiles, Code of Practice

mbie.title: Exemption 1.1: general repair, maintenance and replacement
mbie.note: Examples explain the exemption; they do not determine consent requirements for an individual property.

asbestos.title: Check for asbestos before high-pressure spraying on roofs

roof-safety.title: Working on roofs: good practice guidelines
roof-safety.note: The page explicitly warns that it has not been updated for current legislation. Used only for the distinction between edge falls and falls through roofing, not as a current compliance certificate.

herne.title: Herne Bay villa with True Oak corrugate
herne.note: Manufacturer-reported project, not an independently audited result or published quote.

whitby.title: Whitby reroof, recladding and window installation

tauranga-faq.title: Roofing FAQs
tauranga-faq.note: General scheduling estimate, not a measured sample of completed jobs.

superior-time.title: Reroofing costs and project timing
superior-time.note: Provider planning guidance. RoofHub does not adopt this page as a source of regulatory advice.

artisans.title: Roofing services and completion guarantee
artisans.note: A provider-specific guarantee with conditions, not an industry-wide timeframe.

freeman-corr.title: Corrugate profile and pitch guidance
freeman-corr.note: Approximate dimensions; distinguishes continuous sheets from end-lapped roofs.

trs-corr.title: TRS Corrugate specifications
trs-corr.note: Published spans and fasteners have design conditions; they are not a universal fixing schedule.

st-corr.title: Custom Orb specification overview
st-corr.note: Eight-degree roof pitch is stated. Confirm the current product drawing before ordering cover-dependent quantities.

ri-trueoak.title: True Oak Corrugate
ri-trueoak.note: Special deeper corrugate. The fetched page also contains unrelated tray-profile blocks; those were not used as True Oak specifications.

mrm-profiles.title: Code of Practice: profiles, grades and thickness
mrm-profiles.note: Thickness, steel grade, profile and loading need to be considered together. Consult the current code for design.

mrm-pitch.title: Code of Practice: roof pitch and runoff capacity
mrm-pitch.note: Generic minimum pitches are conditional, not approval of any individual product or roof. Online access may request registration.

mrm-underlay.title: Code of Practice: underlay and internal moisture
mrm-underlay.note: Explains moisture absorption, support and ventilation. Not reproduced as an installation specification.

maxam.title: COLORSTEEL MAXAM product information
maxam.note: Site exposure, details and maintenance affect suitability and warranty. Not a universal coastal clearance rule.

cs-care.title: Care and maintenance guidance
cs-care.note: Refer to the current maintenance schedule for the actual product and site; cleaning requires safe access.

ird-gst.title: Charging GST
ird-gst.note: 15% standard GST conversion is applied only where the source expressly identifies its tax basis.

bitz-cover.title: Seller specification: corrugate effective cover
bitz-cover.note: Archived seller listing, closed September 2026. Used only to cross-check 780 mm cover, not as an active price offer. Confirm the same profile on the current order.

rc-maxam.title: MAXAM corrugated sheets, 0.55 stated gauge
rc-maxam.note: Description states NZD 27.80/lm plus GST, about 760 mm cover and a 50 lm minimum. The headline total is a minimum-order amount, not a metre rate.

bunnings-corr-painted.title: Armorsteel 0.4 mm Ironsand corrugated roofing, per metre
bunnings-corr-painted.note: Fetched listing shows NZD 30.35/lm. Effective cover and GST wording were not established in the retrieved product text. 845 mm is not assumed to be effective cover.

bunnings-corr-zinc.title: Armorsteel 0.4 mm zinc corrugated sheet, 3 m
bunnings-corr-zinc.note: NZD 64.94 per 3 m sheet. GST and effective cover not established in retrieved product text; no tax-inclusive area conversion is published.

bunnings-corr-galv.title: Armorsteel 0.4 mm galvanised corrugated sheet, 3 m
bunnings-corr-galv.note: NZD 67.93 per 3 m sheet. Same retailer as the zinc and painted observations, not independent market quotes.

mitre-corr.title: Roofing Industries Slimline corrugated iron, colour
mitre-corr.note: NZD 29.97/lm. Product title says 762 mm but the retrieved width field is inconsistent. Thickness and confirmed usable cover are not established here.

mitre-gst.title: Payment and pricing policy
mitre-gst.note: States quoted prices include GST. This policy establishes tax basis, not effective cover or product gauge.

wbs-corr.title: Steel & Tube Custom Orb ZINCALUME, 3 m
wbs-corr.note: Fetched page shows NZD 68.85 and 88.08, both tax-inclusive, without an unambiguous active-price distinction. Kept out of the priced ledger pending confirmation.

roofcrowd-catalog.title: Roofing profile catalogue
roofcrowd-catalog.note: Custom Orb catalogue range is NZD 16.41 to 26.40 excluding GST. The retrieved catalogue does not establish the charging unit or variant at each endpoint, so this is not treated as a per-metre quote.

kennedys-orb.title: Custom Orb on a Kennedys Bush home
kennedys-orb.note: Publisher-reported project. Corrugated pitched areas and membrane flat areas belong to one home, not one universal roof specification.

kings-brooklyn.title: Brooklyn re-roof project
kings-brooklyn.note: Publisher reports completion in June 2025. Work account and photographs, not a published invoice or independent inspection.

element-island.title: Coastal Island Bay project
element-island.note: 2021 project using a legacy MAXX specification. Not evidence that the same named product is the current choice for every coastal roof.

element-brooklyn.title: Suburban Brooklyn reroof
element-brooklyn.note: 2021 project includes asbestos-cement removal and different profiles on upper and lower roofs. Historical ENDURA terminology retained as attribution.

wlr-kelburn.title: Central Terrace, Kelburn project account
wlr-kelburn.note: Multiple projects share this page. Only the named Central Terrace account is used; no price or measured roof area is disclosed.

st-plumbdek.title: Plumbdek profile
st-plumbdek.note: Manufacturer profile identity and published 3° starting pitch. Confirm the current specification for the supplying branch.

roofcrowd-plumbdek.title: Plumbdek product specification
roofcrowd-plumbdek.note: 765 mm cover and 0.40/0.55 mm BMT references. No unambiguous public price was recovered in this review; specification evidence only.

st-plumbdek-machine.title: Plumbdek production in Christchurch
st-plumbdek-machine.note: Dated manufacturer account confirms the Christchurch production investment and 0.40/0.55 mm steel options. It is not a current stock guarantee.

dim-veedek.title: Veedek roofing profile
dim-veedek.note: Manufacturer lists 755 mm cover, 810 mm sheet width and a 3° starting minimum. The performance table supports 0.40 and 0.55 mm; an N/A column is not treated as an available thickness.

ri-trimrib.title: Trimrib product family
ri-trimrib.note: Use the named Trimrib family and local variants. Unrelated Eurostyle boilerplate on the page is not evidence that Trimrib is a concealed-fix tray.

ri-trimrib-library.title: Trimrib S, TS and V specification listing
ri-trimrib-library.note: Manufacturer-authored library entry describes the swage variants and a 3° starting minimum. It does not justify assigning one universal cover to every Trimrib variant.

ri-trimrib-details.title: Trimrib CAD and flashing details directory
ri-trimrib-details.note: The directory lists both soft-edge and scribed/notched ridge details. Listing a detail is not approval for every roof; use the matching current drawing and specification.

freeman-five.title: Five Rib roofing profile
freeman-five.note: The stated family varies from 754 to 765 mm cover and 25 to 29 mm rib height. Its own guidance distinguishes the 3° starting minimum from a 10° end-lapped condition.

freeman-six.title: Six Rib roofing profile
freeman-six.note: Six Rib is a separate product geometry. Do not substitute five-rib order dimensions or accessories based only on visual similarity.

trs-five.title: TRS5 longrun profile
trs-five.note: Manufacturer lists a maximum effective cover of 760 mm, 0.40/0.55 mm BMT and a 3° starting minimum. Roof-specific load and drainage conditions remain relevant.

mrm-flashings.title: Code of Practice: flashings
mrm-flashings.note: Sections 8.8.1 and 8.8.2 distinguish soft-edge and notched options. Low trapezoidal profiles are not universally required to use notched flashing. Read the current online Code of Practice; a web summary is not installation design.

mrm-bmt.title: Base metal thickness definition
mrm-bmt.note: BMT refers to metal thickness before coatings. An unexplained merchant gauge is not automatically a BMT specification.

mrm-ponding.title: Code of Practice: ponding
mrm-ponding.note: Drainage and ponding context. A profile label or coating does not replace roof-specific pitch and drainage design.

bunnings-five.title: Armorsteel 830 mm Big 5, 0.4 mm, Thunder Grey
bunnings-five.note: Indexed product text lists $30.35/lm. 830 mm is not accepted as confirmed effective cover. Colour, order length, local availability and current checkout price need confirmation.

bunnings-gst.title: Online and special-order terms
bunnings-gst.note: NZ online and special-order terms establish the GST-inclusive price convention. Terms are evidence of tax basis, not another independent price observation.

mitre-five-colour.title: Roofing Industries roofing iron, colour
mitre-five-colour.note: Indexed product listing gives $31.28/lm and a 0.40 mm Trimrib option. Confirm the actual selected variant and branch; no effective cover is assigned from this listing.

mitre-five-unpainted.title: Roofing Industries roofing iron, unpainted
mitre-five-unpainted.note: Indexed product listing gives $23.38/lm. A malformed width field is excluded, not silently corrected into an effective-cover measurement.

renovation-five.title: New 5 Rib zinc roofing, 3.6 m
renovation-five.note: Indexed listing: $73 per 3.6 m sheet, new Armorsteel Zenium, 0.4 BMT, 760 mm coverage. GST basis was not established. This is new stock as described, not a recycled-sheet benchmark.

rc-five-held.title: 5 Rib MAXAM 0.55 listing with conflicting description
rc-five-held.note: Held out of the five-rib price ledger: the title says 5 Rib but the descriptive text says corrugate. Do not republish its price as a verified five-rib offer until the seller resolves the profile.

diy-five-archive.title: Closed new five-rib sheet listing
diy-five-archive.note: Closed seller listing, not a current offer. Excluded from the current price ledger; the original listing can provide historical context only.

cc-magnaflow.title: MagnaFlow coating system
cc-magnaflow.note: Manufacturer description of the coating system. The finish name does not establish profile dimensions or approve a site.

cc-warranty.title: Warranty assessment and conditions
cc-warranty.note: Location, environment and maintenance conditions matter. No universal distance-from-the-sea rule or guaranteed service life is inferred.

point-wells-trimrib.title: Point Wells residential roofing project
point-wells-trimrib.note: Contractor-reported project combines a named Trimrib roof with other roof systems and detailed skylight work. No standalone roof price or measured roof area established.

garnet-trimrib.title: Garnet Road residential project
garnet-trimrib.note: The account identifies Trimrib roofing and a separate Spanlok wall-cladding system. Roof and cladding dimensions must not be merged into one roof-area allowance.

eastern-beach-trimrib.title: Eastern Beach renovation
eastern-beach-trimrib.note: Builder-reported renovation includes replacing metal tiles with Trimrib and updating skylights. The wider renovation is not a priced roofing case study.

splash-hut-plumbdek.title: Plumbdek at the Splash Hut, Christchurch
splash-hut-plumbdek.note: Manufacturer-authored April 2023 project account. The same story syndicated elsewhere is one account, not another independent project. Roof price and measured area not disclosed.

aspect-trimrib.title: Trimrib No-Swage project
aspect-trimrib.note: Contractor-authored project listing. Its $1m-$2m budget field is not identified as the roofing contract price and is not used as roof-cost evidence. Project location is not inferred from the contractor address.

canterbury-t-rib.title: The multi-purpose rural solution, Canterbury
canterbury-t-rib.note: Supplier-reported T-Rib roof and cladding project. 12 m by 25 m building dimensions are not a measured roof-surface area. A malformed thickness unit is not used in RoofHub specifications.
